# Mechanic inventory (generated by tools/mechanic_inventory.py; do not edit)

164 mechanics (every Fandom keyword in `data/import` plus card kinds the keyword field does not name). Status: 20 done, 23 partial, 121 missing. Hand-kept data: `data/glossary/mechanics.json`; plan and order: `docs/ai/roadmap-open.md` item K.

"Waiting" = staged cards (not playable yet) that use it; a card can wait on several mechanics, so the sum is larger than the pool. "Playable" = shipped cards that use it (keyword found in the text, approximate). "(unverified)" = status guessed from the glossary pattern when the list was seeded on 2026-10-18 (a guess is never "done"); check the engine before relying on it. Prep R/D/L = rules source / card data / lever measured (fields `prep.rules`, `prep.data`, `prep.lever`); the card-session prep subagents fill them two heads ahead.
